rationale: FX03 fired because cost_currency was stored as U_USD, but the raw SOI presents the flagged amortized-cost values under dollar-denominated Amortized Cost and Fair Value columns. The adjacent/preceding row in the same table explicitly carries dollar signs for par, amortized cost, and fair value, and the flagged Fenix delayed-draw row continues in those same columns. U_USD is therefore a USD unit label rather than evidence of a non-USD cost currency.
